description: Modular Django Service-Layer & Selector Architecture (Explicit Domain Services, Read Selectors, Strict ORM Boundaries & Zero-Logic Views)

recommended_surface_bindings.description: Explicit domain services.py and selectors.py separation, thin views/serializers, explicit select_related/prefetch_related, and isolated AAA testing
invariants: Django views, templates, and REST serializers contain zero domain mutation logic; all writes execute through explicit keyword-only functions in services.py (@transaction.atomic)
All multi-table reads execute through explicit query functions in selectors.py using select_related() / prefetch_related() to prevent N+1 queries
Database migrations are never auto-generated or applied without explicit human operator approval
